scenario_theses.permanent_loss: AI infrastructure capex slows sharply; major hyperscaler internalizes or dual-sources connectivity; Scorpio fails to become a durable fabric franchise; margins and multiple collapse.
scenario_theses.bear: Astera remains a good retimer/switch supplier but customer concentration persists, Broadcom/Marvell pressure pricing, and growth normalizes quickly.
scenario_theses.base: Scorpio becomes a second major franchise, Aries/Taurus/Leo continue scaling across multiple accelerator platforms, COSMOS improves switching costs, and owner cash compounds strongly but valuation normalizes.
scenario_theses.bull: Astera becomes a rack-scale connectivity control point across PCIe/CXL/Ethernet/UALink and optical/custom solutions, with multiple hyperscalers and accelerator vendors; power-law category expansion resembles early platform winners.

interpretation: Current price demands roughly low-to-mid-20s owner-cash/share CAGR for a decade under a still-premium terminal multiple. This is demanding, but not impossible for a category-creating early platform winner; valuation alone is not a hard veto.
